title: Public Release
description: The first official stable release of the client. All core features are finalized and operational. Thank you for all the feedback during the testing period!

changes.detail: Finalized settings panel UI and implemented dark theme toggles.
Major memory leak in the AI component leading to performance stability.
Implemented basic sidebar navigation and container switching logic.
Home and Code containers added with initial content placeholders.
Implemented initial JSON fetching logic for version and status checks.
